projects.title: TITAN (Multi-Agent Market Microstructure BackTesting Library)
projects.description: Titan is a high‑performance backtesting library for algorithmic trading strategies built on a modern C++20 core with a Python-first interface, peaking at 8M orders/sec throughput and 128 μs per order latency.It is designed for realistic Level‑2 / Level‑3 (order‑by‑order) market simulations, multi‑agent experiments, and research‑grade performance studies. Primary Innovation is the ability to have agents compete against each other within the same simulated market, allowing for the emergence of complex market microstructure dynamics and the precise study of endogenous market impact.

projects.title: Dream2AI (Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework)
projects.description: Developed and pitched at the LabLab.ai event at MindsDB HQ in San Francisco, Dream2AI is an agentic framework designed for training robust RL "brains" in high-fidelity 3D environments. It features a high-performance FastAPI backend that manages real-time WebSocket streaming (60 FPS at 1280x720) from AI2-THOR/ProcTHOR to a custom React frontend. This architecture allows researchers to monitor live agent telemetry and execute manual overrides via a responsive HTML5 Canvas, bridging the gap between complex physics simulations and interactive AI evaluation.

projects.title: Frost Risk Forecasting ML Pipeline (F3 Data Challenge)
projects.description: Built a multi-horizon frost forecasting system using 15 years of CIMIS weather data across 18 stations. Engineered 25+ domain-specific features and trained 160+ LightGBM models across 3–24h horizons.Designed a Weighted Ensemble Knowledge Distillation framework that outperformed climatology, dew-point, persistence, and general LightGBM models—achieving ROC-AUC ≈ 0.99 and higher PR-AUC across all horizons (0.87 → 0.61).

projects.title: Bullish-AI (AI-powered trading agent)
projects.description: AI-driven trading agent designed to automate investment portfolio management. Through continuous improvements, Integrating FinBERT-powered sentiment analysis and other quantative metrics This fusion enables the AI to make adaptive, data-driven trading decisions in dynamic market conditions.A key innovation is the use of FinBERT, a transformer-based NLP model, to analyze news headlines in real-time and classify sentiment as positive, negative, or neutral. Additionally, the bot employs a dynamic position sizing strategy, adjusting trade volumes based on market conditions, risk exposure, and sentiment strength. By combining these elements, the AI seeks to make smarter, more risk-aware investment decisions.

projects.title: High-Performance C++ Matching Engine
projects.description: Implemented a high-performance, multithreaded order-matching engine simulating a limit order book, supporting market and limit orders at 10,000+ orders/sec.Designed custom price-heap data structures and a thread-safe producer–consumer pipeline using mutexes and condition variables, and validated system stability through Monte Carlo-based stress testing.
